tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Search youth programs in the California cities Kyds Activities serves, one city at a time (`city` slug, defaults to Lodi). Filters: free-text query (program name or description), category (Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming and others), child age in years, free-only, or season. Returns up to 1

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Full details for one program by slug: description, schedule, ages, cost, registration timing, location and the signup link.

tools.name: search_daycares
tools.description: Search state-licensed daycares in the California cities Kyds Activities serves, one city at a time (`city` slug, defaults to Lodi). Filters: child age in months, program kind (daycare, preschool, after_school), setting (in_home or center), and owner-verified listings only. Returns up to 10 daycares

tools.name: get_daycare
tools.description: Full details for one licensed daycare by slug, including license, hours, tuition, languages, subsidies and capacity by age band (infant through kindergarten) when the daycare has filled it in.

tools.name: list_upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming family events in one city Kyds Activities serves (`city` slug, defaults to Lodi): open houses, workshops, community days, storytimes and sports clinics. These are single-day or short events, not ongoing classes.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details for one family event by slug: date, time, place, cost and link.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The program categories currently in the Kyds Activities directory (for example Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming, Dance), spelled exactly as the category filter accepts them.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: The California cities Kyds Activities currently serves (Lodi Kids Activities is its Lodi site), live from the database, with the city slug the search filters take.

tools.name: city_stats
tools.description: Totals for one city: number of programs and licensed daycares, share claimed by their owners, share with a Spanish description, share free, and programs by category.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Lists published editorial guides — parent-facing articles like 'How to pick a summer camp.' Pass `city` for another city's guides (each city has its own blog); defaults to Lodi.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown body of a published editorial guide by slug.

tools.name: upcoming_registrations
tools.description: Programs whose registration opens soon (default: the next 60 days), soonest first, for one city or every city Kyds Activities serves.

tools.name: nearby_programs
tools.description: Programs within a radius in miles of a latitude and longitude point.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: Public parent reviews for a program or daycare: rating, text, reviewer first name only, and season.

tools.name: program_events_feed
tools.description: Upcoming practices, games, scrimmages and cancellations for one program over the next 30 days.

tools.name: site_directory
tools.description: A structured map of Kyds Activities' public pages and content sections, the same content as its llms.txt.

tools.name: parent_list_saves
tools.description: Returns the signed-in parent's saved programs and daycares. Each row has a `kind` field of 'program' or 'daycare' and a link to its detail page.

tools.name: parent_save_program
tools.description: Save a program to the parent's hub. Accepts either the program UUID or its slug (e.g. 'youth-soccer-league'). Optionally associate the save with one or more specific kids (by UUID or name) so the kid filter in /account → Saved Programs picks it up. Requires consent.

tools.name: parent_unsave_program
tools.description: Remove a saved program from the parent's hub. Accepts either the program UUID or its slug. Requires consent.

tools.name: parent_list_kids
tools.description: Returns the parent's kids on file: name, age, interests and school.

tools.name: parent_add_kid
tools.description: Add a kid to the parent's account. Requires consent.

tools.name: parent_list_tours
tools.description: Returns the parent's daycare tour requests with status.

tools.name: org_list_leads
tools.description: Returns recent daycare leads + program saves for the org.

tools.name: org_list_programs
tools.description: Returns the org's programs.

tools.name: org_update_program_capacity
tools.description: Set the listing status on a program (accepting / full / waitlist_only / closed_for_season). Requires consent.

tools.name: org_reply_to_review
tools.description: Post an org response to a review. Requires consent. Replies are one-shot per review.

tools.name: parent_me
tools.description: Returns the signed-in parent's profile + preferences.

tools.name: parent_update_prefs
tools.description: Update parent notification + language preferences.

tools.name: parent_update_kid
tools.description: Updates a kid's name, birthdate, interests or school. Special-needs notes can be changed only on the Kyds Activities account page.

tools.name: parent_remove_kid
tools.description: Remove a kid from the parent's account. Irreversible — deletes the kid record and any kid-linked enrollments/reviews remain but become orphaned (kid_id set null).

tools.name: parent_list_enrollments
tools.description: Returns the parent's enrollments (programs their kid is signed up for).

tools.name: parent_report_enrollment
tools.description: Records that the parent enrolled their kid in a program (the 'I'm In' button). Accepts the program id or slug.

tools.name: parent_save_daycare
tools.description: Save a daycare to the parent's hub.

tools.name: parent_submit_review
tools.description: Submits a review for a program or daycare. One review per parent per program or daycare.

tools.name: parent_my_reviews
tools.description: Reviews the parent has submitted.

tools.name: parent_my_household
tools.description: Returns the parent's household members + shared kids. If no household exists yet, returns null.

tools.name: parent_invite_household_member
tools.description: Invite a co-parent / partner / grandparent to share this household. They receive a one-time invite link by email; on accept, they join the household and can see all kids + saves.

tools.name: parent_accept_household_invite
tools.description: Accept a household invite using the token from the invite link.

tools.name: parent_leave_household
tools.description: Leave the current household. If you're the owner and there are other members, ownership transfers to the longest-tenured member.

tools.name: parent_my_upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming program events (practices, games, scrimmages) for the parent's enrolled programs. Covers next 30 days by default. Cancellations included as 'canceled' status.

tools.name: parent_calendar_subscribe_url
tools.description: Returns the parent's personal iCal feed URL — subscribe in Google/Apple/Outlook Calendar to see practices + games in your normal calendar app. Refreshes hourly.

tools.name: parent_request_tour
tools.description: Submit a daycare tour request. Returns the tour id + status='requested'.

tools.name: parent_cancel_tour
tools.description: Cancel a tour request you previously submitted.

tools.name: parent_my_waitlist_positions
tools.description: Daycare waitlists the parent is on, with current position.

tools.name: parent_my_applications
tools.description: Daycare applications the parent has submitted.

tools.name: parent_recommended_for_me
tools.description: Programs matched to the parent's primary kid's age + interests. Simple matcher today — surfaces top 10 active programs that include the kid's age in their range, weighted by interest overlap.

tools.name: parent_revoke_my_tokens
tools.description: Revokes every AI assistant connection (MCP token) issued under the signed-in parent's account.

tools.name: org_dashboard
tools.description: Org dashboard summary — program count, leads in last 7d, new saves in last 7d, listing-status breakdown.

tools.name: org_update_profile
tools.description: Update the org's profile (website, phone, email, logo_url, instagram).

tools.name: org_update_program
tools.description: Update an existing program's editable fields.

tools.name: org_archive_program
tools.description: Soft-archive a program (active=false). Hides from public directory but preserves history.

tools.name: org_confirm_listing_fresh
tools.description: Confirm a program listing is still accurate (resets the stale-nudge timer).

tools.name: org_list_program_events
tools.description: List upcoming events for a program owned by this org.

tools.name: org_add_program_event
tools.description: Add a single event (practice, game, scrimmage, picture day, cancellation, etc.) to a program's calendar.

tools.name: org_cancel_program_event
tools.description: Mark a program event as canceled. Enrolled parents see this in their hub + iCal.

tools.name: org_analytics
tools.description: Org-level analytics — page views, saves, contacts in a date window.

tools.name: org_generate_promo_kit_url
tools.description: Returns a URL to the org's downloadable promo kit (QR poster + share card) for a given program.

tools.name: daycare_capacity
tools.description: Get current capacity by age band for the daycare(s) this org owns.

tools.name: daycare_set_capacity
tools.description: Upsert capacity for one age band on a daycare. Age bands: infant, toddler, twos, threes, fours, prek, kindergarten.

tools.name: daycare_list_tours
tools.description: Tour requests for the org's daycare(s).

tools.name: daycare_respond_to_tour
tools.description: Respond to a tour request — confirm with a date/time, propose alternates via notes, or decline.

tools.name: daycare_list_waitlist
tools.description: Current waitlist queue for the org's daycare.

tools.name: daycare_list_applications
tools.description: Submitted applications for the org's daycare.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_reviews, parent_invite_household_member · Private data: search_daycares, list_cities, parent_list_kids, parent_remove_kid, parent_report_enrollment, parent_accept_household_invite, parent_revoke_my_tokens, org_analytics · Public sink: city_stats, org_reply_to_review, parent_submit_review, parent_invite_household_member, parent_request_tour, org_update_profile, org_generate_promo_kit_url · Destructive: parent_unsave_program, parent_remove_kid.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_reviews, parent_invite_household_member · Private data: search_daycares, list_cities, parent_list_kids, parent_remove_kid, parent_report_enrollment, parent_accept_household_invite, parent_revoke_my_tokens, org_analytics · Public sink: city_stats, org_reply_to_review, parent_submit_review, parent_invite_household_member, parent_request_tour, org_update_profile, org_generate_promo_kit_url · Destructive: parent_unsave_program, parent_remove_kid

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
